hooks.commandWindows: $d = (Get-Location).ProviderPath; while ($d -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d '.git'))) { $parent = [System.IO.Directory]::GetParent($d); if ($null -eq $parent) { $d = $null } else { $d = $parent.FullName } }; if (-not $d) { exit 0 }; $hook = Join-Path $d '.codex/hooks/native_gate.ps1'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $hook -PathType Leaf)) { exit 0 }; & $hook; exit $LASTEXITCODE
